upsert.notes: Canonical NC State invasive bladder-cancer immunotherapy record. This supersedes the older generic ncsu-bladder-immunotherapy entry for the same active intravesical IL-12 study.

upsert.center: Colorado State University Veterinary Teaching Hospital / Flint Animal Cancer Center
upsert.contacts: Colorado State University Veterinary Teaching Hospital / Flint Animal Cancer Center clinical trials team
upsert.notes: The registry study linked to this record is the CSU trial titled Clinical Testing of Canine T cells Engineered to Target Osteosarcoma and Soft Tissue Sarcoma in Combination with Oral Immunotherapy. CSU's current Veterinary Teaching Hospital and Flint Animal Cancer Center listings both show the study. The old Tufts center label was corrected to avoid a false site assignment.

upsert.funding: Owners pay the initial exam and screening. After enrollment, Auburn states the remainder of the trial is funded for up to two months, including tumor biopsy, rechecks, bloodwork and chemotherapy.
upsert.notes: Current Auburn ongoing palbociclib oncology trial for dogs with measurable mammary carcinoma, melanoma, squamous cell carcinoma, histiocytic sarcoma or AGASACA. Prior cancer treatment is allowed if disease is progressing at enrollment.
